title: Deuteronomy Chapter 10 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Deuteronomy chapter 10 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 10 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Deuteronomy Chapter 10.

questions.question: What did the LORD command Moses to make when he was told to come up into the mount?
questions.correctAnswer: An ark of wood
questions.explanation: The LORD said to make an ark of wood when Moses was told to come up into the mount, as stated in Deuteronomy 10:1.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10, what was written on the new tables of stone?
options: The words that were in the first tables which Moses broke
The names of the twelve tribes
questions.correctAnswer: The words that were in the first tables which Moses broke
questions.explanation: The LORD said He would write on the tables the same words that were on the first tables which Moses broke, as found in Deuteronomy 10:2.

questions.question: What type of wood was used to make the ark?
questions.correctAnswer: Shittim wood
questions.explanation: Moses made an ark of shittim wood as specified in Deuteronomy 10:3.

questions.question: What did the LORD write on the tables according to the first writing?
questions.correctAnswer: The ten commandments
questions.explanation: The LORD wrote the ten commandments on the tables according to the first writing as described in Deuteronomy 10:4.

questions.question: After coming down from the mount, where did Moses put the tables?
options: In the ark which he had made
In the hands of the priests
questions.correctAnswer: In the ark which he had made
questions.explanation: Moses put the tables in the ark which he had made after coming down from the mount, as recorded in Deuteronomy 10:5.

questions.question: Where did Aaron die according to Deuteronomy 10?
questions.correctAnswer: Mosera
questions.explanation: Aaron died and was buried at Mosera as stated in Deuteronomy 10:6.

questions.question: Who ministered in the priest's office after Aaron died?
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar his son
questions.explanation: Eleazar, Aaron's son, ministered in the priest's office after Aaron's death according to Deuteronomy 10:6.

questions.question: What is described as 'a land of rivers of waters' in this chapter?
questions.correctAnswer: Jotbath
questions.explanation: Jotbath is described as a land of rivers of waters in Deuteronomy 10:7.

questions.question: Which tribe did the LORD separate to bear the ark of the covenant?
questions.correctAnswer: Levi
questions.explanation: The LORD separated the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant as mentioned in Deuteronomy 10:8.

questions.question: True or False: Moses stayed on the mount forty days and forty nights the second time according to Deuteronomy 10.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Moses stayed in the mount forty days and forty nights according to the first time, indicating the second stay, as stated in Deuteronomy 10:10.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD gave the tribe of Levi an inheritance among their brethren.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Levi had no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according to Deuteronomy 10:9.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD commanded the Israelites to fear Him, walk in His ways, love Him, and serve Him with all their heart and soul.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:12 clearly states that the LORD requires Israel to fear Him, walk in all His ways, love Him, and serve Him with all their heart and soul.

questions.question: True or False: The tribe of Levi was chosen to fight in battles for Israel.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The tribe of Levi was separated to bear the ark and minister before the LORD, not to fight battles, as stated in Deuteronomy 10:8.

questions.question: Which of these locations did the children of Israel journey to immediately after Beeroth of the children of Jaakan?
questions.correctAnswer: Mosera
questions.explanation: The children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth to Mosera, as recorded in Deuteronomy 10:6.

questions.question: In Deuteronomy 10, what comes first in the sequence of events?
options: Moses hewing two tables of stone
The tribe of Levi being separated
questions.correctAnswer: Moses hewing two tables of stone
questions.explanation: First, Moses hewed two tables of stone (Deuteronomy 10:1-3), before Aaron's death (verse 6), the separation of Levi (verse 8), and Israel's journey to Gudgodah (verse 7).

medium.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 10 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Deuteronomy Chapter 10 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10:9, what is the inheritance of the tribe of Levi?
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:9 states that Levi has no part nor inheritance with his brethren because the LORD is his inheritance, fulfilling God's promise to the tribe.

questions.question: How long did Moses stay on the mount the second time according to Deuteronomy 10:10?
questions.correctAnswer: Forty days and nights
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:10 mentions Moses stayed on the mount forty days and forty nights, similar to the first time, and that the LORD listened to him and spared the people.

questions.question: What instruction did the LORD give Moses in Deuteronomy 10:11?
options: Build an altar on the mount
Take a journey before the people to possess the land
Write a song for the people
questions.correctAnswer: Take a journey before the people to possess the land
questions.explanation: The LORD told Moses to arise and lead the people forward to possess the promised land, as stated in Deuteronomy 10:11.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10:12, what does the LORD require from Israel?
options: To fear, walk in His ways, love, and serve Him with all heart and soul
questions.correctAnswer: To fear, walk in His ways, love, and serve Him with all heart and soul
questions.explanation: Verse 12 clearly states that God's requirement is for Israel to fear Him, walk in His ways, love Him, and serve Him with all their heart and soul.

questions.question: What is the purpose of keeping the commandments and statutes according to Deuteronomy 10:13?
options: For the good of the people
questions.correctAnswer: For the good of the people
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:13 explains that keeping the commandments and statutes is commanded for the good of the people.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 10:14 say belongs to the LORD?
options: The heaven and the heaven of heavens and the earth with all that is in it
questions.correctAnswer: The heaven and the heaven of heavens and the earth with all that is in it
questions.explanation: Verse 14 declares that the LORD owns the heavens, the heaven of heavens, and the earth with everything in it.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10:15, why did the LORD choose Israel above all people?
options: Because the LORD delighted to love their fathers
Because they lived near the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD delighted to love their fathers
questions.explanation: The LORD chose Israel because He delighted in loving their fathers, as stated in Deuteronomy 10:15.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 10:16 instruct Israel to do with their hearts?
options: Circumcise the foreskin of their heart and be no more stiffnecked
questions.correctAnswer: Circumcise the foreskin of their heart and be no more stiffnecked
questions.explanation: Verse 16 commands Israel to circumcise their hearts figuratively, removing stubbornness and turning fully to God.

questions.question: Based on Deuteronomy 10:9 and 10:11, what is the relationship between the LORD being Levi's inheritance and the command to lead the people into the promised land?
options: Because Levi had land, they were to lead the people
Levi's inheritance being the LORD signifies their spiritual role, while Moses leads the people to possess the land
Levi's inheritance was the promised land
Levi was not involved in the journey
questions.correctAnswer: Levi's inheritance being the LORD signifies their spiritual role, while Moses leads the people to possess the land
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:9 shows Levi's inheritance is God's presence, emphasizing their spiritual duties, while 10:11 commands Moses to lead the people to the physical land promised to their fathers.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 10:16 promise will happen if Israel circumcises the foreskin of their heart and is no longer stiffnecked?
options: The LORD will not destroy them
The LORD will bless them with many children
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will not destroy them
questions.explanation: When combined with Deuteronomy 10:10, which speaks of the LORD not destroying the people, circumcising the heart as instructed in 10:16 leads to God's mercy and preservation.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 10:12-13 teach about practical Christian living?
options: By emphasizing rituals and sacrifices only
By requiring love, fear, obedience to commandments for the good of the people
questions.correctAnswer: By requiring love, fear, obedience to commandments for the good of the people
questions.explanation: These verses emphasize loving God wholeheartedly, fearing Him, walking in His ways, and obeying His commandments for the welfare of the community.

questions.question: True or False: Deuteronomy 10:17 teaches that the LORD regards persons and takes bribes.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 17 clearly states that the LORD does not regard persons nor takes reward, showing His impartiality and justice.

questions.question: What virtue is exemplified by the LORD's care for orphans, widows, and strangers in Deuteronomy 10:18-19?
questions.correctAnswer: Justice and love
questions.explanation: The LORD executes judgment for the fatherless and widows and loves the stranger, teaching believers to practice justice and love toward vulnerable people.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10:20, what three actions should believers take towards the LORD?
options: Fear Him, serve Him, cleave to Him
Ignore Him, serve idols, swear falsely
Fear Him, isolate from others, seek riches
Serve others, fear men, cleave to possessions
questions.correctAnswer: Fear Him, serve Him, cleave to Him
questions.explanation: Verse 20 instructs believers to fear the LORD, serve Him, and cleave to Him, illustrating total devotion and loyalty.

questions.question: True or False: Deuteronomy 10:10 says that the LORD refused to listen to Moses and destroyed the people.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 10 states that the LORD hearkened unto Moses and would not destroy the people, showing God's mercy.

hard.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 10 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Deuteronomy Chapter 10.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10, what attribute of God is emphasized by the phrase 'which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward'?
options: God shows partiality to the rich
God is indifferent to human actions
questions.correctAnswer: God is impartial and just
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:17 describes God as one who does not show partiality nor accepts bribes, emphasizing His impartiality and justice.

questions.question: In Deuteronomy 10:18, which groups does the LORD specifically execute judgment for and show love toward?
questions.correctAnswer: The fatherless, widow, and stranger
questions.explanation: Verse 18 states that God executes judgment for the fatherless and widow and loves the stranger by providing food and clothing.

questions.question: What reason does Deuteronomy 10:19 give for loving the stranger?
options: Because you were strangers in Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Because you were strangers in Egypt
questions.explanation: Verse 19 commands love for the stranger because the Israelites themselves were once strangers in Egypt, encouraging empathy based on shared experience.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT part of what the LORD requires of Israel according to Deuteronomy 10:12-13?
options: To serve the LORD with all heart and soul
To build altars on every hill
To keep the commandments and statutes
questions.correctAnswer: To build altars on every hill
questions.explanation: Verses 12-13 outline fearing God, loving, serving, and keeping commandments as requirements, but do not mention building altars on every hill, which is forbidden elsewhere (Deut. 12).

questions.question: In Deuteronomy 10:16, what does the phrase 'circumcise the foreskin of your heart' metaphorically mean?
questions.correctAnswer: To remove stubbornness and hard-heartedness
questions.explanation: Verse 16 uses 'circumcise the heart' figuratively to call for repentance and softening of a stubborn heart, a theme echoed in Jeremiah 4:4.

questions.question: Deuteronomy 10:20 commands the people to fear the LORD, serve Him, cleave to Him, and swear by His name. Which New Testament passage echoes this call to devotion?
questions.correctAnswer: Matthew 22:37-38
questions.explanation: Matthew 22:37-38 echoes the requirement to love God with all heart, soul, and mind, paralleling Deuteronomy 10:20's call to fear, serve, and cleave to God.

questions.question: What historical event is referenced in Deuteronomy 10:22 to highlight God's blessing on Israel's population growth?
options: The giving of the Ten Commandments
questions.correctAnswer: The Exodus from Egypt
questions.explanation: Verse 22 contrasts the 70 persons who went down to Egypt with the multitude like stars God made them, referring to the Exodus and God's blessing on Israel's growth.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10:8-9, what is unique about the tribe of Levi's inheritance?
options: They received a double portion of land
They had no land inheritance but the LORD Himself was their inheritance
They inherited the land of Canaan first
They were given gold and silver instead of land
questions.correctAnswer: They had no land inheritance but the LORD Himself was their inheritance
questions.explanation: Verses 8-9 state Levi was set apart to minister, had no land inheritance among brethren, but the LORD was their inheritance.

questions.question: Which literary device is evident in Deuteronomy 10:14 where 'heaven and the heaven of heavens' are mentioned?
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: Verse 14 uses parallelism, repeating 'heaven' and expanding to 'heaven of heavens' to emphasize God's sovereign ownership of all creation.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word translated as 'terrible' in Deuteronomy 10:17 most closely mean in its original context?
questions.correctAnswer: Fearsome or awe-inspiring
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term 'yare' often translated as 'terrible' conveys awe and reverence due to God's mighty power, as in Deuteronomy 10:17.

questions.question: How long did Moses stay on the mount during the second time he received the tables according to Deuteronomy 10:10?
questions.correctAnswer: Forty days and forty nights
questions.explanation: Verse 10 specifies Moses stayed forty days and nights on the mount, the same duration as the first time he received the commandments.

questions.question: Which action did Moses perform immediately after receiving the new tables of stone as stated in Deuteronomy 10:5?
options: He read the commandments aloud to the people
He put the tables in the ark he had made
He broke the previous tables again
He built an altar on the mount
questions.correctAnswer: He put the tables in the ark he had made
questions.explanation: Verse 5 states Moses came down and put the tables into the ark he had constructed as commanded by God.

questions.question: True or False: Deuteronomy 10:21 states that God has done 'great and terrible things' witnessed by the Israelites' own eyes.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 21 affirms that God is praised for doing great and terrible things that the Israelites have personally seen.

questions.question: True or False: According to Deuteronomy 10:11, God told Moses to stay on the mountain longer before leading the people into the promised land.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 11 commands Moses to arise and lead the people to possess the land; it does not instruct him to stay longer on the mountain.

questions.question: Which other biblical passage echoes the theme of God’s impartiality and judgment for the vulnerable as seen in Deuteronomy 10:17-18?
questions.correctAnswer: Psalm 146:9
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:9 echoes God's care for the oppressed, fatherless, and widow, paralleling Deuteronomy 10:18’s themes of justice and love toward the vulnerable.

theological.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 10 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Deuteronomy Chapter 10 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What was the Lord's command to Moses regarding the tables of stone after the first ones were broken?
options: Hew two new tables of stone like the first and make an ark of wood
Write new commandments on a scroll and hide it
Construct a golden calf as a new symbol of covenant
Make a new altar with burnt offerings
questions.correctAnswer: Hew two new tables of stone like the first and make an ark of wood
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:1 records that the Lord commanded Moses to hew two tables of stone like unto the first and to make an ark of wood to carry them.

questions.question: Which tribe was set apart specifically to bear the ark of the covenant and minister before the Lord?
questions.correctAnswer: Levi
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:8 specifies that the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant and to minister before Him, indicating their unique priestly role.

questions.question: What reason does Deuteronomy 10:9 give for Levi having no inheritance among his brethren?
options: Because the LORD is his inheritance
Because they chose to live apart in the wilderness
Because they were the smallest tribe
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD is his inheritance
questions.explanation: According to Deuteronomy 10:9, Levi has no part or inheritance with his brethren because the LORD himself is his inheritance, fulfilling God's promise.

questions.question: How long did Moses stay on the mount the second time to intercede for Israel, and what was the result?
options: Forty days and forty nights; the LORD hearkened and did not destroy Israel
Seven days; the LORD sent fire upon the camp
Three days; the LORD gave new laws
Twenty days; the people repented fully
questions.correctAnswer: Forty days and forty nights; the LORD hearkened and did not destroy Israel
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:10 states Moses stayed on the mount for forty days and nights, and the LORD listened to him and refrained from destroying the people.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 10:12-13, what does the LORD require from Israel?
options: To fear God, walk in His ways, love Him, serve with all heart and soul, and keep His commandments
To build altars and offer sacrifices daily
To conquer all surrounding nations by force
To maintain strict dietary laws only
questions.correctAnswer: To fear God, walk in His ways, love Him, serve with all heart and soul, and keep His commandments
questions.explanation: These verses summarize the covenant requirements emphasizing loving God wholeheartedly and obeying His commandments for their good.

questions.question: What theological truth about God is revealed in Deuteronomy 10:14 regarding His sovereignty?
options: The heavens and the earth belong to the LORD, indicating His universal ownership
God is limited to the earthly realm
God is a local deity of the mountain
questions.correctAnswer: The heavens and the earth belong to the LORD, indicating His universal ownership
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:14 declares that the heaven and the heaven of heavens and the earth with all that is in it belong to the LORD, affirming His absolute sovereignty over all creation.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 10:16 teach about the spiritual condition of Israel's heart?
options: They must circumcise the foreskin of their heart and be no longer stiffnecked
They should circumcise only their physical bodies
They must build new altars to renew their hearts
They are already perfect in heart
questions.correctAnswer: They must circumcise the foreskin of their heart and be no longer stiffnecked
questions.explanation: This verse uses circumcision metaphorically to call for inner spiritual renewal and obedience, removing hardness of heart (stiffneckedness).

questions.question: Which attributes of God are emphasized in Deuteronomy 10:17?
options: God is great, mighty, terrible, impartial, and does not accept bribes
God is weak and accepts bribes
God is only a judge of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: God is great, mighty, terrible, impartial, and does not accept bribes
questions.explanation: Verse 17 highlights God's greatness, might, and fearsome nature, along with His impartiality and refusal to accept bribes, underscoring His perfect justice.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 10:18 describe God's concern for vulnerable groups?
options: He executes judgment for the fatherless and widow and loves the stranger by providing food and clothing
He ignores the fatherless and widow
He only cares for the wealthy
He commands them to fend for themselves
questions.correctAnswer: He executes judgment for the fatherless and widow and loves the stranger by providing food and clothing
questions.explanation: This verse reveals God's justice and mercy toward the vulnerable, emphasizing His care for orphans, widows, and foreigners.

questions.question: What theological principle can be synthesized from Deuteronomy 10:19 and 10:18 regarding social ethics?
options: Love for the stranger is commanded because Israel was once strangers in Egypt and God loves the stranger
Strangers should be excluded to protect Israel's purity
Justice applies only to Israelite citizens
The stranger must assimilate fully without any special treatment
questions.correctAnswer: Love for the stranger is commanded because Israel was once strangers in Egypt and God loves the stranger
questions.explanation: Verses 18 and 19 together teach that God's love for the stranger and Israel's obligation to love strangers is grounded in their own history as foreigners in Egypt.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 10:20 instruct Israel to relate to the LORD in worship and allegiance?
options: Fear, serve, cleave to Him, and swear by His name
Serve other gods alongside the LORD
Fear the priests more than God
questions.correctAnswer: Fear, serve, cleave to Him, and swear by His name
questions.explanation: This verse calls for reverence, exclusive service, loyalty, and oath-taking in God's name, highlighting a covenantal relationship.

questions.question: What does the combined teaching of Deuteronomy 10:5 and 10:11 reveal about the continuity of God's covenant and promise?
options: God commands keeping the covenant (tables in the ark) and calls Israel to possess the promised land as sworn to their fathers
God gave up on the covenant and delayed the land possession
The covenant is replaced by new laws
The land promise is only conditional on military success
questions.correctAnswer: God commands keeping the covenant (tables in the ark) and calls Israel to possess the promised land as sworn to their fathers
questions.explanation: Verse 5 shows Moses obeying God's command about the covenant tablets, while verse 11 shows God urging Israel to begin entering the promised land, affirming God's faithfulness.

questions.question: What doctrinal teaching about God's impartial justice can be derived from Deuteronomy 10:17 and 10:18?
options: God is impartial and executes justice for the vulnerable without partiality or bribery
God favors the rich and powerful
God is indifferent to social injustices
questions.correctAnswer: God is impartial and executes justice for the vulnerable without partiality or bribery
questions.explanation: Verse 17 emphasizes God's impartiality and justice, and verse 18 details His active concern for orphans, widows, and strangers, showing His righteous governance.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that God is partial and accepts bribes. What does Deuteronomy 10:17 actually teach about God's nature?
options: God is a great, mighty, and terrible God who does not regard persons nor take reward
God is easily influenced by wealth
God favors certain people over others
questions.correctAnswer: God is a great, mighty, and terrible God who does not regard persons nor take reward
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:17 refutes claims of partiality by affirming God's greatness, might, and impartiality, and explicitly states He does not take bribes.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 10:22 reflect God's faithfulness in the context of redemptive history?
options: From seventy persons in Egypt to a multitude like stars, showing God's blessing and fulfillment of promise
Israel remained a small tribe without multiplication
God broke His promise to multiply Israel
questions.correctAnswer: From seventy persons in Egypt to a multitude like stars, showing God's blessing and fulfillment of promise
questions.explanation: Verse 22 demonstrates the fulfillment of God's covenantal promise to Abraham about multiplication, highlighting God's faithfulness in redemptive history.
